name: genui-docker
description: A repository to build and deploy GenUI docker images. GenUI is a collection of web services for interactive molecular generation, QSAR modelling and chemical space visualization.

paragraphs: The files in this repository are used to build and deploy the GenUI platform from Docker images. In total, five Docker images are defined for GenUI:
features: genui-base -- A base image that contains all dependencies of the Python backend. It is used to derive all the other images below. It should only be necessary to rebuild this image if the dependencies of the backend…

genui-base-cuda -- This base image is derived from genui-base and contains the CUDA Toolkit in addition to the standard backend libraries (see The NVIDIA CUDA Base Image). Like in the case of genui-base, this image does…

genui-main -- This image is derived from genui-base and adds GenUI frontend GUI and also the source code for the Python backend. Therefore, this image contains the complete GenUI web application and its source code. It…

genui-worker -- Image based on genui-base intended to be deployed as a worker consuming Celery tasks submitted to the Redis message queue. The worker runs the same code as the backend of genui-main and multiple workers…
genui-gpuworker -- Image based on genui-base-cuda that can be configured to access one or more NVIDIA GPUs on the host system and should consume the tasks in the gpu queue.
